query:
SELECT course_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        course_id,
        MIN(embedding <#> $1::vector) AS distance
    FROM course_audiences
    GROUP BY course_id
    ORDER BY distance ASC
    LIMIT 5
) t
UNION ALL
SELECT course_id
FROM course_audiences
WHERE to_tsvector('english', audience)
@@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $2)
